svg.title: Guardium in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: 70% less time spent on auditing, and 25% of data security analysts’ time saved, from a Forrester Total Economic Impact study IBM reports. Under 60 minutes to deploy Guardium Data Protection from AWS Marketplace, with no Guardium expertise needed, IBM says. IBM reports both figures on its Guardium Data Protection page, from a Forrester Total Economic Impact study. IBM’s page for the study says IBM commissioned it from Forrester Consulting, which interviewed four Guardium Data Protection clients and combined them into one composite organization.
